gateResults.evidence: The final Release owning-repository suite completed across 21 projects with 1,631 total tests, 1,597 passed, 0 failed and 34 classified skips; Search and representative suites also passed. Existing dependency, documentation, nullability and analyzer warnings remained outside the Search build, which passed with -warnaserror.

The separate review approved the bounded decision matrix, optional-capability caveat, candidate-versus-complete distinction, scalar JSON/literal-only boundary, dialect costs and static/runtime snapshot test; the review artifact is retained with its tested hash.
The capability-card snapshot passes against generated XML and runtime SearchSchema descriptions; the Search suite and five registered semantic harnesses also passed.
The card's eight source signatures are checked against generated static XML and runtime constructor order, and every runtime source description exposes columns.

knownLimitations: The card is a bounded decision guide, not a catalog dump or a substitute for the versioned Search source, request, coordinate, resource and completion contracts linked from it.
Static XML and runtime descriptions verify signatures and columns; they do not prove that a particular deployment has installed the Search plugin or that an external root is readable.

The owning-repository suite retained existing restore, package-vulnerability, XML-documentation, nullability and analyzer warnings; no warning was introduced by the Search build, which passed with -warnaserror.
No package was published, pushed, released or installed, and no sibling repository was edited.
